description: WATER EPI Lab Drinking Water Repository is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tushara Rajeev, Yutong Chen. The WATER EPI Lab Drinking Water Repository is a collection of datasets containing regulated contaminant concentration estimates in community water systems across the US, made available for both researchers and the public. Contaminant concentrations are derived from millions of routine compliance monitoring records reported by community water systems to primacy agencies. Coverage: the United States. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
